Fezandipiti

Poison Fairy

Paldea · Generation 9 · Legendary Pokémon

Fezandipiti is a Poison/Fairy-type Retainer Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9), and is classed as a Legendary Pokémon. It stands 1.4 m tall and weighs 30.1 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (125), with a base stat total of 555.
